findings.issue: History-axis dates are reconstructed from positive-gross box-office rows. A degraded production refresh with zero resolved grosses—possible pre-season—has no durable record after the current render. If the season later returns to Live, the chart omits that refresh and interpolates between forecasts instead of preserving the required gap.
findings.suggestion: Persist every production refresh date independently of gross and forecast rows, and use those dates to construct the history axis.

findings.issue: Roster loading does not validate the group structure or title types. Non-string ranked or dark-horse entries can satisfy the length/distinctness checks and then fail later while catalog titles are sorted, violating the requirement that persisted schemas be validated at the load boundary.
findings.suggestion: Validate display_name, players, usernames, pick mappings, and every title as the expected string/mapping types before constructing Group and PlayerPicks.

findings.issue: Override loading validates category and status but accepts invalid types for alias_of and release_date. A quoted date or non-string alias therefore reaches chart filtering or catalog sorting and fails deep in the pipeline instead of at the schema boundary.
findings.suggestion: Require alias_of to be a non-empty string and release_date to be a date during load_overrides, with path-and-title-specific errors.
